_comment: Machine-readable service catalogue structure. Mirrors the reusable pages -> categories -> services shape documented in blueprint/03-services-and-request-engine.md. Replace all placeholder values; do not carry over Sanad's own catalogue content.

quote_model._comment: The current Sanad implementation has NO formal quote/approval workflow — pricing is flat fee-line-items summed into a total. See GAP-REGISTER.md before assuming a richer quote state machine (draft->sent->accepted->rejected) exists to configure. If required, this is new engineering.
quote_model.existing_mechanism: fee_items (flat line items) + payments ledger + discount/write-off fields on the request

tax._comment: No functioning tax/VAT calculation engine exists in the current codebase — only identity-labeling fields (vat_registered, vat_rate, prices_include_tax) that print on documents but are never used in a computation. See GAP-REGISTER.md.
